[11/16 Phonics/Writing | Phonics, Learning Target] I can break words apart, put word parts together, and hear the beginning and ending sounds in words.
[11/16 Phonics/Writing | Writing, Learning Target] I can help write a story with my class using beginning, middle, and end.
[11/16 Phonics/Writing | Writing, Learning Target] I can use sequence words like first, then, and last to tell what happened in order.
[11/16 Phonics/Writing | Writing, Vocabulary & Strategy] letters, alphabet, sequencing, narrative, trees, shelter, shade
[11/15 ELA | Reading (Thank you trees), Vocabulary & Strategy] Thankful, shelter, grow, wooden
[11/15 ELA | Reading (Thank you trees), Success Criteria] Session 6 determine the meaning of unknown words
[11/16 math | Lesson Title] Unit 3: Addition & Subtraction Within 5 and Shapes
[11/16 math | Learning Target] I can recall addition and subtraction facts within 5.
[11/16 math | Vocabulary & Strategy] subtract, subtraction, take away, less, less than, minus, minus sign, plus, plus sign
[SS 11/16 | Economics and Traditions, Learning Target] I can tell how people earn money and make decisions about how they spend it.
[SS 11/16 | Economics and Traditions, Vocabulary & Strategy] Spending, saving, veteran, goods, services
[SS 11/16 | Economics and Traditions, Standard] SSKE2; SSKE3; SSKE4; SSKH1 (Veterans’ Day)
